venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.notes_summary: Another Wednesday on the books at Close Company Atlanta. Opening bartender got us started up & took advantage of the slow start with ABKing our space.

highlights.text: Another Wednesday on the books at Close Company Atlanta.

venues.name: D&C DC
venues.notes_summary: **DC — Thursday 2/19.** Slow start, picked up quickly around 7; most reservations arrived 6:30-8. Fast flips and bar seats open to avoid a wait. Team stepped into multiple roles (Tyler floor then barback, Alex and Ian owned the bar top, Khaleel on the door, James helped run food). Energy faded ~11 apart from a lively 6-top birthday group at the bar; everyone closed out by 12:30 before last call. Kitchen: 16% of sales; a few tables came hungry and ordered multiple courses. MOD: Cory.

venues.name: D&C EV
venues.weather: A little wet but not too bad
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Thursday 2/19.** Mellow start; steady in-and-out flow around dinner; full around 8:30pm through ~11:30pm when foot traffic died; last guests were lingerers; lots of industry love. Comps $62.90 (1.9%). Door: warmer weather and strong 6pm start with tourists before Broadway shows and dinner; mostly at capacity, twos occasionally waited 20-30 minutes; new-to-D&C guests needed a reminder of the seated experience, and one guest drank too much; welcomed Dominick (past EV barback), Carolyn Gil and company, Dan from Manhatta, Izadora from Saga; a few groups around 1am. No no-shows. Repairs: the usual.
